name: ImageField
description: ImageInput bound to an `ImageFieldValue` form field. Pair it with `imageSchema()`.
signature: ({ label, hint, warning, optional, required, aside, className, disabled, ...control }: ImageFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: alt
props.description: The picture's text alternative. Default "Chosen image".

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when no Field label names the control.

props.name: aside
props.description: Right side of the label row: a live value readout or a small link.

props.name: aspect
props.description: Width ÷ height the crop keeps, or `"free"`. Default `"free"`.

props.name: aspects
props.description: Shapes to choose between in the dialog.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: fields
props.description: Show number fields in the dialog. Default true.

props.name: hint
props.description: The message line's resting text. Only when the format or consequence is not obvious (R2.8).

props.name: label
props.description: Names the control. Omit only when a group legend or `aria-label` names it instead.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ cropRole: string; cropLabel: string; cropInstructions: string; freeInstructions: string; zoom: string; aspect: string; free: string; left: string; top: string; width: string; height: string; changeImage: string; chooseImage: string; dropImage: string; chooseImageFirst: string; save: string; saving: string; saved: string; notSaved: string; cancel: string; removeImage: string; removing: string; savingImage: string; saveFailed: string; removeFailed: string; anyImage: string; notSupported: (name: string, formats: string) => string; tooLarge: (name: string, size: string) => string; unreadable: (name: string) => string; tooSmall: (width: string, height: string) => string; maxFileSize: (size: string) => string; minPixels: (width: string, height: string) => string; noImage: string; chosenImage: string; replace: string; crop: string; edit: string; remove: string; addImage: string; imageRequired: string; }> | undefined
props.description: Formatting and wording locale; defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider.

props.name: onEdit
props.description: Show an Edit button beside an image, for a richer editor of the host's. The field does not know what it opens; set the value when it is done.

props.name: onReject
props.description: Called for each file refused by the requirements.

props.name: onSave
props.description:
Upload as the dialog saves, with the run's `{ signal, setProgress }`. Resolve with a URL to
make it the value; otherwise the change itself is. Without it the change becomes the value
and the form's submit uploads it: the library never does.

props.name: optional
props.description: Marks the label "Optional". Prefer this over marking required fields.

props.name: output
props.description: The cropped image: size in pixels, media type (default WebP) and quality.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shows the image without its actions; it cannot be changed.

props.name: required
props.description: Shows the required marker. Pass `required` to the control as well.

props.name: requirements
props.description: What an image must satisfy: types, bytes, minimum dimensions and the application's own check.

props.name: shape
props.description: `round` shows a round thumbnail and crop. Default `rect`.

props.name: warning
props.description: Non-blocking warning in the reserved message slot; errors take precedence.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the component should ignore user interaction.
Takes precedence over the `disabled` prop on the `<Field.Control>` component.
